newsitem.title: USA: GFSB to repurchase up to 15 pct shrs.
newsitem.headline: GFSB to repurchase up to 15 pct shrs.

text.p: GFSB Bancorp Inc, the holding company of the Gallup Federal Savings Bank, said Tuesday it intends to repurchase shares of its common stock.
The company said it is set to repurchase up to 142,312 shares, which is about 15 percent of its current outstanding shares of common stock.
The company said the repurchases are expected to be made on the open market.
The company said the repurchased shares will be retired and made available for general corporate and other purposes, including the issuance of shares in connection with the exercise of stock options.
The company said the repurchase program is expected to be completed by June 28, 1997, at which time the company may decide to continue the program.
